standard_prerequisites.name: Cone triangles as distinguished triangles
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies distinguished triangles with cone triangles of homomorphisms up to isomorphism of triangles; every TR verification normalizes to this form.

standard_prerequisites.name: Rotated triangles and the rotated cone
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemmas lemma-rotate-triangle and lemma-rotate-cone
standard_prerequisites.use: Give the rotated triangle isomorphisms and the distinguishability of the rotated cone triangle, closing both directions of TR2.

core_obligations: TR1 (proof lines 1226-1236): every triangle isomorphic to a distinguished one is distinguished; (K, K, 0, 1, 0, 0) comes from the admissible short exact sequence 0 to K to K to 0; and any homomorphism f : K to L gives the distinguished cone triangle (K, L, C(f), f, i, -p) by lemma-the-same-up-to-isomorphisms.

TR2, forward direction (proof lines 1238-1257): if (Y, Z, X[1], g, h, -f[1]) is distinguished, an admissible short exact sequence realizes it up to isomorphism; rotating back and applying lemma-rotate-triangle identifies the result with the cone triangle of delta[-1], and precomposing with -1 on Y gives the cone triangle with -p, which is distinguished by lemma-the-same-up-to-isomorphisms.

TR2, converse direction (proof lines 1257-1270): a distinguished triangle is isomorphic to a cone triangle (K, L, C(f), f, i, -p); its rotation is isomorphic to (L, C(f), K[1], i, p, f[1]), which is distinguished by lemma-rotate-cone, so the rotated triangle is distinguished.

TR3 (proof lines 1272-1280): normalize both distinguished triangles to cone triangles by lemma-the-same-up-to-isomorphisms and apply lemma-functorial-cone to the commutative diagram given by f, f', a, b.
proof_roadmap: Verify TR1 from admissible short exact sequences and cone triangles.
Verify TR2 forward: rotate, identify with the cone triangle of delta[-1] via lemma-rotate-triangle, adjust the sign, and conclude.
Verify TR2 converse: rotate the cone triangle and apply lemma-rotate-cone.
Verify TR3 by normalizing to cone triangles and applying lemma-functorial-cone.
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies TR1, TR2 and TR3 for the homotopy category of differential graded modules over a differential graded algebra (statement lines 1224-1230). The proof (lines 1232-1280) is a real diagram chase: TR2 requires rotating an isomorphism class of triangles through the cone-triangle model of both directions, composing triangle isomorphisms with sign adjustments, and closing the converse with the rotated-cone lemma; TR3 reduces to the functoriality of the cone. H2: the cited lemmas carry individual steps, but the sign bookkeeping and the two-direction rotation assembly are the argument.
